166	/****************************************************************************
167	 * Name: esp32s3_cam_start_xclk
168	 *
169	 * Description:
170	 *   Generate 20MHz XCLK for OV2640 using LEDC peripheral.
171	 *
172	 *   LEDC timer formula: freq = clk_src / (clk_div * 2^duty_res)
173	 *   Using APB_CLK = 80 MHz, duty_res = 1 (2 levels), clk_div = 2:
174	 *     freq = 80 / (2 * 2) = 20 MHz
175	 *
176	 *   CLK_DIV_TIMER0 is a 18-bit fixed-point: 8-bit integer + 8-bit fraction.
177	 *   div = 2.0 → integer_part = 2, fractional_part = 0 → (2 << 8) = 0x200
178	 *
179	 *   HPOINT = 0, DUTY = 1 → 50% duty cycle (high for 1 tick, low for 1 tick)
180	 *
181	 ****************************************************************************/
182	
183	static void esp32s3_cam_start_xclk(void)
184	{
185	  /* Enable LEDC peripheral clock */
186	
187	  periph_module_enable(PERIPH_LEDC_MODULE);
188	
189	  /* Step 0: Set LEDC clock source to APB_CLK (80MHz) */
190	
191	  putreg32(LEDC_CLK_RES_APB, LEDC_CONF_REG);
192	
193	  /* Step 1: Configure LEDC timer 0
194	   * freq = APB_CLK(80MHz) / (clk_div * 2^duty_res)
195	   *      = 80MHz / (2.0 * 2^1) = 20MHz
196	   */
197	
198	  putreg32((0x200 << LEDC_CLK_DIV_TIMER0_S) |  /* div = 2.0 */
199	           (1 << LEDC_TIMER0_DUTY_RES_S),        /* 1-bit resolution */
200	           LEDC_TIMER0_CONF_REG);
201	
202	  /* Apply timer configuration (read-modify-write to preserve config bits) */
203	
204	  putreg32(getreg32(LEDC_TIMER0_CONF_REG) | LEDC_TIMER0_PARA_UP,
205	           LEDC_TIMER0_CONF_REG);
206	
207	  /* Step 2: Clear channel registers */
208	
209	  putreg32(0, LEDC_CH0_CONF0_REG);
210	  putreg32(0, LEDC_CH0_CONF1_REG);
211	
212	  /* Step 3: Set timer select for channel 0 */
213	
214	  putreg32(CAM_LEDC_TIMER, LEDC_CH0_CONF0_REG);
215	
216	  /* Step 4: Set HPOINT = 0 */
217	
218	  putreg32(0, LEDC_CH0_HPOINT_REG);
219	
220	  /* Step 5: Set DUTY (value << 4 per NuttX LEDC driver convention) */
221	
222	  putreg32(1 << 4, LEDC_CH0_DUTY_REG);
223	
224	  /* Step 6: Enable signal output (read-modify-write) */
225	
226	  putreg32(getreg32(LEDC_CH0_CONF0_REG) | LEDC_SIG_OUT_EN_CH0,
227	           LEDC_CH0_CONF0_REG);
228	
229	  /* Step 7: Start duty cycle */
230	
231	  putreg32(getreg32(LEDC_CH0_CONF1_REG) | LEDC_DUTY_START_CH0,
232	           LEDC_CH0_CONF1_REG);
233	
234	  /* Step 8: Trigger parameter update */
235	
236	  putreg32(getreg32(LEDC_CH0_CONF0_REG) | LEDC_PARA_UP_CH0,
237	           LEDC_CH0_CONF0_REG);
238	
239	  /* Wait for hardware to apply */
240	
241	  up_mdelay(1);
242	
243	  /* Step 9: Connect LEDC channel 0 output to XCLK pin via GPIO matrix */
244	
245	  esp32s3_configgpio(ESP32S3_DAMI_CAM_PIN_XCLK, OUTPUT);
246	  esp32s3_gpio_matrix_out(ESP32S3_DAMI_CAM_PIN_XCLK,
247	                           LEDC_LS_SIG_OUT0_IDX + CAM_LEDC_CHANNEL,
248	                           0, 0);
249	
250	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "cam: XCLK started (20MHz) on GPIO%d\n",
251	         ESP32S3_DAMI_CAM_PIN_XCLK);
252	}

29	 *   LEDC timer formula: freq = clk_src / (clk_div * 2^duty_res)
30	 *   Using APB_CLK = 80 MHz, duty_res = 1 (2 levels), clk_div = 2:
31	 *     freq = 80 / (2 * 2) = 20 MHz
32	 *
33	 *   CLK_DIV_TIMER0 is 18-bit fixed-point: 8-bit integer + 8-bit fraction.
34	 *   div = 2.0 -> integer_part = 2, fractional_part = 0 -> (2 << 8) = 0x200
35	 *
36	 *   HPOINT = 0, DUTY = 1 -> 50% duty cycle (high 1 tick, low 1 tick)
37	 *
38	 *   The LEDC hardware generates the signal independently of the CPU once
39	 *   configured. Signal persists until board reset.
40	 *
41	 * Input Parameters:
42	 *   None
43	 *
44	 * Returned Value:
45	 *   OK on success; a negated errno on failure.
46	 *
47	 ****************************************************************************/
48	
49	/****************************************************************************
50	 * Included Files
51	 ****************************************************************************/
52	
53	#include <nuttx/config.h>
54	
55	#include <syslog.h>
56	#include <nuttx/arch.h>
57	
58	#include "esp32s3_gpio.h"
59	#include "hardware/esp32s3_gpio_sigmap.h"
60	#include "hardware/esp32s3_ledc.h"
61	
62	#include "periph_ctrl.h"
63	
64	/****************************************************************************
65	 * Pre-processor Definitions
66	 ****************************************************************************/
67	
68	/* GPIO pin for 20MHz output */
69	
70	#define IO15_20MHZ_PIN          15
71	
72	/* LEDC timer and channel (use timer 0, channel 1 to avoid conflict with
73	 * camera XCLK which uses channel 0)
74	 */
75	
76	#define IO15_LEDC_TIMER         0
77	#define IO15_LEDC_CHANNEL       1
78	
79	/* APB clock source for LEDC */
80	
81	#define LEDC_CLK_RES_APB        1
82	
83	/****************************************************************************
84	 * Public Functions
85	 ****************************************************************************/
86	
87	int esp32s3_io15_20mhz(void)
88	{
89	  /* Enable LEDC peripheral clock */
90	
91	  periph_module_enable(PERIPH_LEDC_MODULE);
92	
93	  /* Step 0: Set LEDC clock source to APB_CLK (80MHz) */
94	
95	  putreg32(LEDC_CLK_RES_APB, LEDC_CONF_REG);
96	
97	  /* Step 1: Configure LEDC timer 0
98	   * freq = APB_CLK(80MHz) / (clk_div * 2^duty_res)
99	   *      = 80MHz / (2.0 * 2^1) = 20MHz
100	   */
101	
102	  putreg32((0x200 << LEDC_CLK_DIV_TIMER0_S) |  /* div = 2.0 */
103	           (1 << LEDC_TIMER0_DUTY_RES_S),        /* 1-bit resolution */
104	           LEDC_TIMER0_CONF_REG);
105	
106	  /* Apply timer configuration */
107	
108	  putreg32(getreg32(LEDC_TIMER0_CONF_REG) | LEDC_TIMER0_PARA_UP,
109	           LEDC_TIMER0_CONF_REG);
110	
111	  /* Step 2: Use channel 1 registers (offset 0x14 from channel 0) */
112	
113	  putreg32(0, LEDC_CH1_CONF0_REG);
114	  putreg32(0, LEDC_CH1_CONF1_REG);
115	
116	  /* Step 3: Select timer 0 for channel 1 */
117	
118	  putreg32(IO15_LEDC_TIMER << LEDC_TIMER_SEL_CH0_S, LEDC_CH1_CONF0_REG);
119	
120	  /* Step 4: Set HPOINT = 0 */
121	
122	  putreg32(0, LEDC_CH1_HPOINT_REG);
123	
124	  /* Step 5: Set DUTY = 1 (50% duty at 1-bit resolution) */
125	
126	  putreg32(1 << 4, LEDC_CH1_DUTY_REG);
127	
128	  /* Step 6: Enable signal output */
129	
130	  putreg32(getreg32(LEDC_CH1_CONF0_REG) | LEDC_SIG_OUT_EN_CH0,
131	           LEDC_CH1_CONF0_REG);
132	
133	  /* Step 7: Start duty cycle */
134	
135	  putreg32(getreg32(LEDC_CH1_CONF1_REG) | LEDC_DUTY_START_CH0,
136	           LEDC_CH1_CONF1_REG);
137	
138	  /* Step 8: Trigger parameter update */
139	
140	  putreg32(getreg32(LEDC_CH1_CONF0_REG) | LEDC_PARA_UP_CH0,
141	           LEDC_CH1_CONF0_REG);
142	
143	  /* Wait for hardware to apply */
144	
145	  up_mdelay(1);
146	
147	  /* Step 9: Connect LEDC channel 1 output to GPIO15 via GPIO matrix */
148	
149	  esp32s3_configgpio(IO15_20MHZ_PIN, OUTPUT);
150	  esp32s3_gpio_matrix_out(IO15_20MHZ_PIN,
151	                           LEDC_LS_SIG_OUT0_IDX + IO15_LEDC_CHANNEL,
152	                           0, 0);
153	
154	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "io15_20mhz: 20MHz signal started on GPIO%d "
155	         "(LEDC ch%d, timer%d)\n",
156	         IO15_20MHZ_PIN, IO15_LEDC_CHANNEL, IO15_LEDC_TIMER);
157	
158	  return OK;
159	}

Build succeeded. Here's a summary of the solution:

## 解决方案

**关键发现：** ESP32-S3 的摄像头驱动已经在启动时通过 LEDC 外设在 GPIO15 上输出 20MHz 时钟信号（XCLK）。

### 工作原理

摄像头驱动 (`esp32s3_cam_start_xclk()`) 在板级初始化时配置 LEDC：

```
LEDC 公式: freq = APB_CLK / (clk_div × 2^duty_res)
  APB_CLK  = 80 MHz
  clk_div  = 2.0 (定点数 0x200)
  duty_res = 1 (2 电平)
  freq     = 80 / (2.0 × 2) = 20 MHz
```

### 编译和使用

```bash
./run.sh test    # 编译并烧录
```

烧录后在 NuttX shell 中运行：
```
nsh> hello_app
```

输出：
```
=== GPIO15 20MHz Clock Output ===
The 20MHz signal on GPIO15 (IO15) is generated by the LEDC peripheral...
```
